esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; PMSA003 particulate matter sensor needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TX → RX2 (the board's RX), RX → TX2 (the board's TX). Added the pmsa003.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; PMSA003 particulate matter sensor needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TX → GP1 (the board's RX), RX → GP0 (the board's TX). Added the pmsa003.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes
